Header.title: Client-Side Background Remover
Header.description: Removing image backgrounds directly in the user's browser (client-side) using modern web technologies (ONNX models and WASM (WebAssembly).

Processor.instructions: Click, drag & drop, or press Ctrl+V to paste
Processor.imageTypeError: Selected file must be a valid image (.png, .jpeg or .webp).

Settings.modelInfo:
Selects the quantization level of the IS-Net segmentation model:

• large: Maximum alpha-matte accuracy highest RAM usage and slowest initial download.

• medium: Half-precision weights virtually identical visual output to 'large' at half the download size.

• small: Quantized weights; fastest download and lowest memory footprint, with minor edge artifacts on fine details like hair.
Settings.typeInfo:
Controls which pixel data is written into the output image:

• foreground: Keeps the detected subject and sets background pixels to transparent (alpha = 0).

• background: Inverts the alpha matte, removing the subject (alpha = 0) and keeping only the background pixels.

• mask: Discards RGB color data from the source image and outputs the raw grayscale segmentation map (white for foreground, black for background)
Settings.formatInfo:
Determines the MIME encoding of the returned Blob:

• png: Lossless compression with full alpha channel support.

• webp: Lossy or lossless compression with alpha channel support; produces significantly smaller file sizes than PNG.

• jpeg: Lossy format without alpha support (transparent areas render black).
Settings.deviceInfo:
Selects the ONNX Runtime execution provider: 

• cpu: Executes inference using WebAssembly (wasm).

• gpu: Attempts hardware acceleration via WebGPU. If the user's browser or GPU does not support WebGPU, the library falls back to cpu.
Settings.qualityInfo: Specifies the compression quality ratio passed to the encoder.
